findings.summary: bare except swallows a failed commit and leaves the record staged silently
behavioural change lands outside the declared write path reckon/crew/promotion.py
after_suite JSON is malformed and unparseable

rubric_text:
VERDICT goal: reckon/crew/plan_review.py:5319 now commits a staging record whose delivering crew run already holds a ledger row, which is the late-delivery defect the node set out to close.
VERDICT done_when: the gate is the node's own test set; head-arm.log records 53 passed EXIT=0 at 898a95dbfa against base-arm.log 51 passed EXIT=0 at 3d4c92834c.
VERDICT write_paths: the declared paths were reckon/crew/promotion.py, the new test and the evidence fragment; the landed source change is in reckon/crew/plan_review.py, which the fence did not name.
VERDICT manifest: read; it claims complete, names both gate logs and the negative control, but its after_suite JSON is malformed at manifest.md:20 and cannot be parsed.
VERDICT diff: read both commits against base 3d4c92834c; three files, 255 insertions, the behavioural change confined to _commit_record_when_run_promoted in reckon/crew/plan_review.py.
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew/routing.py:2949, reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py:1690, reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py:2988, reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:2901, reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:2963
SCORE goal_fidelity: 19
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/plan_review.py:5319 commits the late record through review_records.store_committed_review, the writer a promotion uses.
SCORE evidence: 15
JUSTIFICATION evidence: head-arm.log and base-arm.log are recorded with EXIT lines and the negative control reddens, but manifest.md:20 carries unparseable after_suite JSON.
SCORE scope_discipline: 9
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: the source change lands in reckon/crew/plan_review.py while the declared fence named only reckon/crew/promotion.py, which the diff leaves untouched.
SCORE durability: 19
JUSTIFICATION durability: removing the _commit_record_when_run_promoted call reddens the committed-store assertion in the new test and leaves the staged case green, as negative-control.log records.
SCORE fit: 18
JUSTIFICATION fit: the helper follows the surrounding lazy-import and docstring idiom of reckon/crew/plan_review.py:5313 and introduces no plan or ticket identifier.
SCORE reuse: 20
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the addition calls review_records.store_committed_review and commit_record_write rather than forking the committed-store writer, and a search over reckon/crew found no other late-delivery commit path.
FINDING reckon/crew/plan_review.py:5367 non-blocking: the commit is wrapped in a bare except (OSError, ValueError) returning None, so a failed commit silently leaves the record staged, reproducing the exact outcome the node fixes with no log or refusal.
FINDING reckon/crew/plan_review.py:5319 non-blocking: the behavioural change lands in plan_review.py, outside the declared write path reckon/crew/promotion.py; the manifest's evidence_inputs explains the move, but the fence was violated rather than extended.
FINDING /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261114T095134283939-wave3-clive-anchored-a-plan-is-reviewed-before-it-s39/manifest.md:20 non-blocking: after_suite is not valid JSON because the command string is truncated and carries an embedded comma before log_path, so a reader cannot parse the after arm from the manifest and must fall back to the log.
